# Search log triage

`customer_support.pb.self_service_deflection.search_log_triage` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Read the raw query strings — especially the ones returning nothing and the ones the customer immediately refined — on a regular cadence, and use the query itself as the candidate article title.

It is the only place in the whole funnel where a customer states, in their own words, a problem you have no answer for, before a ticket exists. Everything else measures the questions you already handle.
